subject.title: Regression: exec intermittently unavailable in isolated cron sessions (was fixed in 2026.4.1)

question: Should this umbrella stay canonical until all three reported modes are resolved, or should maintainers split the remaining routing/status work into narrower issues before landing the wildcard-tool fix?
rationale: The linked PR can close this issue automatically while only claiming one subset, and the status/fail-closed path touches `exec` security policy and false-positive cron health semantics.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Split
options.body: Keep this issue open, remove or adjust closing syntax on the narrow PR if needed, and create or confirm narrower canonical items for scheduler routing and status classification.

options.title: Let Narrow PR Close It
options.body: Allow the wildcard/profile fix PR to close this issue and rely on existing related open issues for any remaining behavior.
